lane: independent source-only privacy and oracle review
verdict: PASS for diagnostics only; runtime remains pending
privacy: Receipts contain fixed source-class/shape counts only; raw key/value, salt, and fingerprints stay out of durable evidence. Opaque identities are transiently passed through CDP and compared in-page.
oracle: Initial-guest equality contributes only matches_initial_guest diagnostics. No assertion consumes it as an exemption; all unexplained overlap remains fatal, including unclassified keys and unchanged values.
categories: The finite source map yields coarse named classes, with every unmapped key assigned unclassified. Shapes are limited to fixed primitive/array/object buckets.
limitation: A class label or matching guest baseline does not bind an observed value to its writer/default. Source tracing and exact default proof remain required before any acceptance exception.
runtime: Not run; root owns browser/resource guard. EXT-D-0015 remains open.
